assumptions.statement: The submitted overall and key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional constraints.
assumptions.impact: All design geometry and area ratios must be recalculated when official GIS/CAD polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, heritage, utility, fire and engineering controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory control, parcel demolition decision or engineering feasibility is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Events, testbeds, governance bodies and service operators are reference mechanisms for professional and public co-design.
assumptions.impact: They are not confirmed government programs, budgets, procurement or investment commitments.

assumptions.statement: Every AI scenario requires purpose limitation, data minimization, visible human review, pause/appeal channels and a non-digital fallback.
assumptions.impact: Scenarios cannot enter pilot operation until data rights, security, accessibility and accountable operators are confirmed.
